message.content: {"basis": "The chart's y-axis is inverted, with values increasing downward (0.0 at the top, 2.5 at the bottom). The blue series starts at a y-position of approximately 1.3 in the year 2000 and ends at a y-position of approximately 2.4 in the year 2017.5. Because the axis is inverted, the final value of ~2.4 is numerically larger than the starting value of ~1.3, indicating an increase in the number of doctors per 1,000 inhabitants over the reporting period. This end-of-period pattern of increased capacity aligns with the physician capacity expansion review pathway.", "option_label": "Route to the physician capacity expansion review pathway"}
